semantic_summary: Evidence-backed first hypothesis: clear the caller far output buffer; construct the SDK OPENFILENAME record; dynamically call GetOpenFileName for mode 0 or GetSaveFileName for mode 1; and confirm replacement when a selected save path already exists. This candidate leaves the observed custom-dialog fallback and path normalization unresolved, so the strict run is diagnostic and is not claimed as a complete reconstruction.
binding_evidence: Packet entry loads the first argument as ES:BX and clears its first byte; callers pass a far pointer. No caller buffer capacity is inferred.
The assigned Win 3.1 SDK COMMDLG.H provides the OPENFILENAME fields and dynamic GetOpenFileName/GetSaveFileName prototypes; its 0x48-byte record is consistent with target initialization offsets.
The target selects function-name offsets 0x1735/0x1753 and mode-specific flags 0x1800/0x0802, and sets nMaxFile to 0x100.
Target save branch calls access(path,0), then USER ordinal 1 and compares the result to 6.
